raise_justifications.desktop/macos/Desktop/Sources/Providers/: The elicitation queue, its staged answers, and its runtime subscription live in ElicitationProjection and ElicitationStore; the provider keeps only the reference and one start call. The per-tool stall guard additionally asks that queue whether a question is waiting, because the judgment needs the surface and StallDetector stays free of elicitation.

update_action_item accepts the realtime `id` alias and backend task writes refresh TasksStore so agent-created tasks appear immediately; already-granted permissions still gate their Settings/drag-card opens behind the granted result.
